label: DynaDish 5
description: 5 GHz point-to-point dish radio, 25 dBi, 867 Mbps; 1x GigE port, RouterOS.
notes: Power method from the mikrotik.com spec table (MikroTik · DynaDish 5): **PoE in: 802.3af/at** (11-60 V) on `eth1`. Input is recorded on the first Ethernet port because the table states the method and voltage but does not name the port. Max power consumption 9 W.
